ai_summary: 3i Infotech Limited has secured a significant three-year purchase order valued at Rs. 24.48 Crore (exclusive of taxes) from a new banking institution in India, commencing January 1, 2027. This contract, providing comprehensive IT Facility Management Services and related infrastructure support, positively impacts future revenue visibility and expands the company's domestic client base. The only notable point is the non-disclosure of the new customer's name, explicitly stated due to confidentiality obligations.
